title: Spring rolls and its sheet at home. How to make veg spring rolls at home? Kunal kapur recipes
description: Missing bahar के चटपटे  Chinese #SpringRolls aur #Manchurian ko? Let's make our favourite Veg Spring Rolls from sheet to filling to frying in a few simple steps, at home!   Also, recipe ke end mai ekk bonus hai, dekhna mat bhoolna! :smiling face with sunglasses:  (Comment below if you know)  00:00 Introduction 00:42 How to make Spring Rolls Sheet? 02:56 How to make Stuffing for Spring Rolls? 04:26 Tips & Tricks  05:13 Filling and Rolling Spring Rolls 06:29 Frying Spring Rolls 08:39 Extra Shots  09:00 Bloopers  Tried other Snacks recipes? Veg Momos Recipe with a Twist | वेज मोमोज रेसिपी: https://youtu.be/gWJePLW3ygc Crispy Potato Wedges Recipe | Masala Aloo Fries: https://youtu.be/ATClTppmahk Masala Kurkure Pasta Namkeen | मसालेदार पास्ता के कुरकुरे: https://youtu.be/G2wjLpch8as How to make French Fries | Crispy Homemade Recipe Restaurant style: https://youtu.be/moaD22jhXo0 Pyaz ki Kachori recipe | प्याज़ की कचौड़ी | Khasta Kachori: https://youtu.be/5AAC5IHy72U  (Veg Spring Rolls) :sparkles: Ingredients:sparkles:   ~For spring roll sheets~  Flour all purpose - 100gms Corn flour - 50gms  (plus extra for dusting)  Salt - a pinch  Water - 160ml (approx) Oil   ~For stuffing~  Oil - 4tbsp Ginger chopped - 2tsp Garlic chopped - 2tsp Onions shredded -½ cup Capsicum shredded - ½ cup Carrots shredded - 1cup Cabbage shredded - 1cup Spring onions chopped - ¼ cup  Soya sauce - 1tbsp Vinegar - 2tsp Salt - to taste Sugar - a pinch  Corn flour - 2 tsp White Pepper powder - a pinch  Sesame oil (optional) - 1tbsp  ~Batter for binding~  Flour (all-purpose)  Water   Method: ~For the sheets~  Mix all the ingredients and make a thin & smooth batter. Heat a non-stick pan and using a cloth rub a little oil on to the surface. Pour a ladle full of batter on to the hot pan, swirl quickly and pour back the batter into the bowl. Let the pancake cook and leave the bottom. Remove and place on to a plate dusted with cornflour. Repeat the same, just remember to keep dusting the pancakes.  ~For the filling~ Heat a pan and add oil. Stir in chopped ginger and garlic. Add onions, carrots, cabbage, capsicum and toss on high heat for 2-3 mins. Add salt, sugar, pepper powder, Siya sauce, vinegar and toss them together.  Make sure most of the water released by veggies is evaporated. Sprinkle the cornflour on top and toss it again. Cook for another 2-3mins. Add sesame oil, mix and remove the veggies on a large plate. Spread them so that they cool off fast.  Place a generous amount of the filling in the centre of the pancake. Fold in the sides first and then roll it up tightly. Towards the end apply a little slurry made with flour and water.   Heat oil and deep fry till crisp. Enjoy!   #KKitchen #KunalKapurRecipes #ChefKunal #kunalkapoor #kunalkapur #chef  Hi, I am Chef Kunal Kapur and this is my space, my channel. asr.full_text: Music When you are preparing to make such a recipe to have the proper quantity you will have to prepare all these ingredients Am talking about Spring Rolls Especially the wrapper and the sheet in which the roll is made and you know its recipe, you can make this recipe from home But yes, you have to have the correct recipe Today we are making spring rolls These are very popular not just in China but also in the Asian subcontinent It is a part of the dishes but is also served as an extra dish There are many more innovations There are some parties And in my marriages as well All of them have Spring Rolls like we can be a starter Everybody enjoys it We also serve it with chaat masala Although chaat masala is not Chinese it is very Indian you all know that To prepare the Spring Rolls' sheet We make a thin batter Normally people eat with chatmasala but chachan Masala is very Indian To make the spring rolls sheets we will make a thin batter I'll take maida and cornstarch a pinch of salt and water mix it well since this is vegetarian roll, there are no eggs are being added to this. Batter is ready. And see how thin is this? It is only a little bit like water. But at the same time, it is coating nicely at the back of the spoon. Coating, But pouring consistency. This is what we call this. We will heat a pan. For this recipe, try and use non stick pan, that is better. A little bit of oil on the pan, this recipe try to use a non-stick pan will be better add little bit of oil on a pan and using a paper and cloth spread this oil and will also clean this once we will stir it well this goes filled with a ladle we need to rotate it and empty out it that's it Put it in a bowl and stir it until it gets empty. And now it's ready. This is how it should be cooked. See how it is easily cooked and will leave the pan on it's own. That's it, it's ready. Make sure to clean the clean before adding batter all the times. Alright, the third batch. Now carefully just take it out and in no time literally no time our spring rolls sheets are ready The vegetables which are there are made using spring vegetables usually. But as of now we have a couple of more standard vegetables like cabbage, carrot, onion and capsicum. We use those vegetables and we taste that one. It is now very difficult to change it. So we'll make the same. Some soy sauce, a pinch of sugar Now we also add sugar so that there's a balance in it as there's soya sauce, a bit of saltiness, sweetener and a bit of vinegar. A bit of pepper powder... let's just toss this together. Just like that Chinese chef who and shakes it all in a walk we raise the whole walk and shake it It's very easy in this we are adding a little sesame oil this is Chinese sesame oil which has a very nutty flavour this is corn starch and in this we will add a dash of water adding it will allow the vegetables cook we'll add more water. and we'll let the cornflour dry. We'll keep and add it to the vegetables. Add a lot of chopped onions and remove the vegetable Cool down completely and then stuff it. Until it cools down, we'll leave. We will then stuff it. While it is cooling I will make all the tips and tricks for perfect spring roll at home. Make sure your springs roll mixture is of course poreng consistency and not coated type. Once you are done cooking the spring roll make a spoon or in one's back. When we cook spring rolls, make sure to cook them in hot oil for them to retain their water. After preparing the sheets of spring roll, you can wrap it individually and put it in deep freezer for an individual one month, but before cooking it, you must consume it in a couple of days as they don't leave for long. So that's the tips & tricks and now on to the rest of the recipe. It has completely cooled down now is the time to fill and roll & fry Spring rolls, very simple, take a sheet of spring rolls just dust off the excess Now we use this sheet to make the the batter of maida and water So what is the make-up of a thick batter of maida and water When we roll a spring roll To make it stick we use this sheet You see this This thick batter Is also called a slurry This is the stuffing We slurry. This stuffing should be placed in the middle like this. Keep the center towards the end. Fold this carefully and tightly. Place this edges in this way and roll it like this. and this we roll the edges towards the top and we will give it a roll and we will give it a roll and we will give it a roll we will give the slurry now we will keep it wrapped oil is hot lets fry one side make sure we have put the oil on it so that it can fry well from both the sides slowly, gradually you can see it's becoming crunchy and this will turn totally brown now. This is ready. Look at this! Nice and crispy. It looks beautiful! Take a sharp knife and just whack it. Nice! Oh! It's hot. And listen to the crunch sound. And obviously it's very hot. Crunchy from the outside, soft, springy to the bite from the inside. Spring rolls. Spin rolls! and then cut the little pieces, and place it over the curry. this is ready.... we will take it out to serve.... and top it with green peas It's nice colour That's what we want Put your favourite side. And our spring rolls are ready. And it happens a lot that extra stuffing is left. So, what can be make by extra stuffing? Let's see this in extra shots. To make Manchurian make with leftover stuffing. We will take the leftover stuffing which includes corn starch, some refined flour and salt Then we will mix everything and now we will fry it Our Manchurian balls are done Right now, I am like a dragon Oh... Yummy Who made this? Increment Dotha Right now I am like a dragon OH Yummy Who made this? Increment Dosa You're getting lunch aren't you?
